bagPolicy.summary: State Farm Stadium enforces a Clear Bag Policy allowing only clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12". Bags larger than 4.5" x 6.5" that are not completely clear are prohibited.
allowed: clear plastic bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12"
prohibited: bags larger than 4.5" x 6.5" that are not completely clear
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions for medically necessary items are allowed after inspection. Diapers and wipes must be in a clear bag, while diaper bags are prohibited.

parking.note: Parking is available through pre-sold permits and single-game options, with general and preferred parking areas. The venue is cashless, requiring credit card payments.

rideshare.note: Use the Black Lot south of the stadium for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Check the event’s parking information for changes.

concessions.note: State Farm Stadium offers a variety of beer options including domestic and premium selections, as well as champagne and alcohol-free choices. Highlights include Veuve Clicquot champagne carts and a selection of draft beers from popular breweries. The venue features numerous bars and portable stands for convenient access to beverages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is on all three concourses, including Lofts and Field Boxes, with elevators near the five entrances. Assistive listening devices are at the Guest Services Offices by Sections 104, 123, 417, and 448 in exchange for an ID. If you arrive in a personal wheelchair or scooter, enter through the ADA Access Control Point at Gate 2.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Once ticketed guests exit the premises, re-entry with a previously scanned ticket is not permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The State Farm Stadium Ticket Office is on the north side and is open Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM, and before major events. It does not take cash. Tickets for stadium events are sold on SeatGeek.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The public entrances are BetMGM Gate 1, Hyundai Gate 2, and Bud Light Gate 3, plus two Gila River Casinos Club Entrances. For NFL games, gates open two hours before kickoff. Concert gate times vary, so check your event page.
